library_preparation_preflight.summary: spring-boot-data-couchbase-test is the Spring Boot 4.x renaming of spring-boot-starter-data-couchbase-test, a thin test-scope aggregator with no JVM classes of its own. The sibling spring-boot-starter-couchbase-test:4.1.1 (same version) is already documented in this repo as containing only META-INF/MANIFEST.MF, LICENSE.txt, NOTICE.txt with no classes, and spring-boot-starter-data-couchbase-test is documented the same way. No setup can produce meaningful coverage for an artifact with no library code; the standard not-for-native-image scaffold path already used for its siblings applies.
risks: Confirm via local Gradle/Native Image verification that spring-boot-data-couchbase-test:4.1.1 indeed ships no class files, the same way its sibling spring-boot-starter-couchbase-test:4.1.1 was confirmed, before finalizing a not-for-native-image metadata entry.
If actual classes are found (unlikely given the precedent), reassess for test-support needs such as testcontainers Couchbase Docker image and Spring Data Couchbase repository setup.
